thread:
Priya: quick sync — we need to lock the launch baseline for the next release. customer pilots + legal added 3 asks that are pushing our window. can we carve safely?

Omar: which asks are blocking infra?

Priya: SSO (ok), audit logs (needed for enterprise), and fine-grained roles (enterprise asks). audit logs and roles are the risky ones.

Lina: roles UI is non-trivial (roles + policy editor). we can ship a simple role label UX and expand later.

Dan: heads-up from sales — key customer will delay signing without roles + basic audit. they said SSO alone isn't enough.

Mei: SSO = OIDC is doable before launch. audit logs need ~2 sprints to get proper retention/query. roles enforcement touches auth path and has perf risk.

Priya: proposal: launch baseline = core features + OIDC SSO + simple quota controls. defer: full audit-query UI and granular role editor to v1.1 (8 weeks post-launch). customers get pilot access for roles.

Omar: +1 to defer. also recommend rollout policy: canary 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with automatic fallback to previous model if latency > 500ms p95. add health-check gating.

Dan: sales ok with OIDC + pilot clause if we add contract milestone for roles delivery (8 weeks). I'll get a soft LOI. :thumbsup:

Lina: I'll mock the minimal role-label UI and add a 'manage roles (beta)' flag. keeps frontend work limited.

Mei: infra action: prepare audit-log ingestion pipeline as 'backfilled' work. we can land hooks but behind flag. means no perf impact at launch.

Priya: action items - I'll update roadmap + milestone tracker, @Omar please draft rollout + fallback playbook, @Lina mock UX skeleton, @Dan get pilot LOI, @Mei prep audit flag.

Omar: will drop a short runbook by EOD.

Dan: will share customer language for pilot.

Lina: attaching quick sketch in #design after this.

deploy-bot: milestone_tracker updated: release_baseline set, deferred_items = [audit-queries, granular-roles].

Priya: thanks everyone — i'll ping legal + PMO once roadmap is updated. we should reconvene Thursday for final sign-off. :calendar:
